sources.pipeline: Slay the Spire Reference - Cards.csv → compile:sts-db → sts-description-enrichment

galleryFieldGuide.draw: base/upgraded counts; conditioned + trigger when draw depends on If/Whenever (icons applied at render time).
galleryFieldGuide.discardEffect: Flat: base, upgraded, random, fromHand — no icon keys; UI maps discard to DISCARD_ICON; descriptions may use [DISCARD].
galleryFieldGuide.orbInteractions: Ordered verbs: channel/evoke/next/repeat; orbIcon + presentation only (no usesIcon).
galleryFieldGuide.multiHit: damageUsesMainField binds to main damage; blockUsesMainField binds to main block (e.g. Reinforced Body); appliesDebuffsUsesMainField binds appliesDebuffs (e.g. poison stacks per application) to multiHitCount / X scaling (Bouncing Flask); multiHitCount { base, upgraded? } for fixed repeat; multiHitEnergyScaling true for X-cost hit count (Skewer, Whirlwind, Reinforced Body, debuff multihit).
galleryFieldGuide.multiHitCount: Per-tier hit count when not energy-scaling.
galleryFieldGuide.multiHitEnergyScaling: X-cost: repeat count follows spent energy (no multiHitCount) — damage (Skewer) or block (Reinforced Body).
galleryFieldGuide.selfExhaustOnPlay: Per tier: base and upgraded booleans — whether playing that copy exhausts the card.
galleryFieldGuide.appliesDebuffs: vulnerable, weak, poison, etc. with base/upgraded stacks; optional per-entry `random` or `randomTarget` (boolean) adds random-target icon beside that debuff; optional per-entry or root `target` tier { base/upgraded: "all enemies" } → AoE icon before that debuff cluster(s).
galleryFieldGuide.heal: Tiered HP healed — card face + [HEAL] placeholder.
galleryFieldGuide.focus: Defect Focus (+/- orbs) — card face + [FOCUS] placeholder.
galleryFieldGuide.mantra: Watcher Mantra — use [MANTRA] or [W] when card.mantra is set; [W] falls back to Weak if mantra absent.
galleryFieldGuide.unplayable: If true, cost orb is hidden (curses / specials).
galleryFieldGuide.canAddCards: Boolean — true when the card adds or inserts cards (hand / draw pile / discard): "Add …", "Put … into your hand", token shuffle into pile; false for recycle-only shuffles (Deep Breath, Reboot), self-shuffle (Tantrum), or reorder-only moves.
galleryFieldGuide.bonusDamage: Extra damage instance (e.g. Bane): same tiers as damage; conditioned + optional trigger string for glyph label; optional `random` / `randomTarget` on tier object.
galleryFieldGuide.bonusBlock: Extra block instance (e.g. Halt in Wrath): tiers + conditioned + trigger; optional `random` / `randomTarget` on tier object.
galleryFieldGuide.randomTargeting: On tier objects `{ base?, upgraded?, … }`: `random: true` or `randomTarget: true` (same meaning) shows the shuffle icon in the gallery (appliesDebuffs entries, damage, block, draw, heal, focus, energy, scry, HP cost, bonus rows, `addCard`, `orbInteractions` rows, discardEffect already supported).

iconCatalog.CONDITIONAL_MARKER: Effect is conditional (paired with draw, energy, etc.)
iconCatalog.ANY_ORB: Generic orb placeholder when color not fixed
iconCatalog.SAME_ORB_AS_EVOKED: Echo orb type from prior evoke
iconCatalog.AOE_ICON: Hits all enemies (paired with damage icon)
iconCatalog.KEY_RETAIN: Retain — card stays in hand at end of turn (tiered boolean on retain).
iconCatalog.KEY_UNPLAYABLE: Unplayable — cannot be played from hand (curses / specials; cost orb hidden).
iconCatalog.CAN_ADD_CARDS: Adds cards into hand — `canAddCards` on card data (distinct from upgrading cards in hand).
